completion_promises.evidence: Created a '### Core Streams' subsection with a markdown table listing all 6 streams (PIPELINE, AGENTS, JARVIS, NOTIFICATIONS, SYSTEM, FLEET) with columns for Stream, Subjects, Retention, Max Age, and Description. Each stream's description matches stream-definitions.json. Also added '### KV Buckets' subsection listing all 4 KV buckets (agent-status, agent-registry, pipeline-state, jarvis-session) with TTL and description. Tests verify each stream name, subject pattern, KV bucket name, and table structure via parametrized tests.

Created a '### Provisioning Commands' subsection with bash code blocks showing: basic provisioning (streams and KV buckets), --dry-run preview, custom NATS_URL, and NATS_CREDS usage. Documents prerequisites (jq, NATS CLI) with link. Updated test_readme.py to accept provision-streams.sh reference (was previously blocked by obsolete test from TASK-DCD-005).

Created a '### Idempotency Guarantees' subsection explaining the check-then-create-or-update pattern with 4 numbered scenarios ([CREATE], [OK], [UPDATE], [ERROR]). Explains that the same pattern applies to both streams and KV buckets. Documents exit code behaviour and the two-line summary output format (Streams: ... / KV Buckets: ...). Explains that it's safe to run on first deploy, on reboot, and after definition changes.

Created a '### Adding a New Stream' subsection with 4 numbered steps: (1) add JSON entry to stream-definitions.json with example, (2) update account permissions in accounts.conf.template, (3) run provision-streams.sh, (4) update tests. Includes a full JSON example with scope: project. Also created '### Project Streams' subsection showing FINPROXY as the existing project stream with isolation explanation.
